Keringanan Iuran JKK diberikan sebesar 50% (lima puluh
persen), sehingga Iuran JKK untuk setiap kelompok
tingkat risiko lingkungan kerja menjadi:

merupakan industri yang memiliki

llm.note: The relief is modelled as half of the normal risk-group JKK rate (which reproduces every reduced rate listed in Pasal 4, e.g. 0,24% to 0,120%) for employers in the listed industries with at least 50 active participants, assuming employer attributes 'industry' and 'bpjs_active_participants'; the later valid_from makes it prevail over the general JKK rule when its condition holds. The JKP recomposition (Pasal 9) and the payment obligation of Pasal 11 do not change the employer premium included in gross income and are not modelled.

output.reason: Employer-paid JKK premiums are added to a permanent employee's gross income for PPh 21. This regulation cuts the JKK contribution rate by 50% for every risk group, for example from 0.24% to 0.120% of monthly wages. The cut applies to qualifying labour-intensive industries with at least 50 active BPJS participants, for contribution months February to July 2025. It therefore changes the JKK amount that enters gross income for these employees. Part of the reduced JKK rate is also reallocated to the JKP contribution.
